description: Update the comment configuration for Git Commit, Go Mod, and Go Work languages to ensure consistent trailing space behavior when toggling inline comments. This change will make the comment toggling behavior match other languages in the codebase for better user experience and consistency.
functional_requirements: Update the Git Commit language configuration to include a trailing space after the '#' comment character
Update the Go Mod language configuration to include a trailing space after the '//' comment character
Update the Go Work language configuration to include a trailing space after the '//' comment character
Ensure the editor's comment toggling functionality properly adds/removes the trailing space for these languages
Maintain existing syntax highlighting behavior while only affecting comment toggling operations
